plan_matrix.assessment: Version sync is complete, but the archive cannot execute its full documented CI and omits the planned management/coverage documents.
Geometry/contact/Chronos APIs exist; threshold semantics and rank-conditioning need strengthening.
Biot and polygonal-smooth gates exist, but current evidence is diagnostic rather than rigorous certification.
Spacetime/QSS scaffolding exists; QSS Node wiring is absent and conditioning is misnamed.
Provenance records exist, but SHA-256, canonical serialization, strict continuity and validation are not implemented.
The factor-2-free formula exists; tensor/residual validation is incomplete.
The n>2 KAM proxy can falsely return Pass.
Snapshot/recompute separation, density metadata and M0 helpers exist; precision/package semantics need refinement.
CheckKind/evidence exist, but JSON robustness, schema and parity are incomplete.
Core formulas exist; the discriminating shape/fixed-V/countermodel guards are absent.

findings.finding: The source bundle omits scripts/, lib/, docs/, README.md, LICENSE, dist/ and prebuilds/ although package.json and tests reference them.
findings.required_action: Regenerate the archive from a checked manifest and fail CI on missing referenced paths.

findings.finding: src/module_node.cpp declares/calls bind_qss_spectroscopy, but qss_spectroscopy_node.cpp does not exist and is absent from the CMake Node source list.
findings.required_action: Add and wire the binder, or remove the Node capability until it exists.

findings.finding: The original Linux CMake build combines -Wl,--no-undefined with a Python extension that is not linked to Python::Python, producing unresolved Py* symbols.
findings.required_action: Link Python::Python when using that linker guard, or adopt an extension-appropriate platform policy.

findings.finding: APIs and fields named SHA-256 use 64-bit FNV-1a; geometry hashes use raw native double bytes.
findings.required_action: Implement real SHA-256 over canonical serialization and validate 64-hex fields.

findings.finding: For n>2, Hessian 'determinant' is the product of diagonal entries. A singular 3x3 Hessian was returned as determinant=1 and Pass/KAM1.
findings.required_action: Use LU/QR/SVD rank and non-degeneracy diagnostics; return Indeterminate when a rigorous result is unavailable.

findings.finding: Mass-shell, V, gamma, proper-time and fixed-P phase are present, but delta_shape_separability, the coupled countermodel and fixed-V gamma^2-1 guard are missing.
findings.required_action: Implement the planned discriminating residuals and regression tests.

findings.finding: P*c, P*c*c and absolute dimensionful residuals can overflow even for finite inputs; ok only means residuals are finite.
findings.required_action: Scale arithmetic, use V=c*((P*c)/H), normalize residuals and separate finite/valid/tolerance status.

findings.finding: Only non-empty strings are checked; malformed hashes/timestamps and skipped stages can be certified.
findings.required_action: Validate hash/timestamp formats, exact stage transitions and coordinate/scale compatibility.

findings.finding: Sampled distances, index-paired tangents and curvature radius alone are reported as a Pass certificate without reach/self-distance/isotopy bounds.
findings.required_action: Rename current output Diagnostic/Candidate and reserve Pass for rigorous topology/thickness guards.

findings.finding: dimensional_residual is hard-coded zero; anisotropy ignores the lower matrix triangle and does not validate symmetry.
findings.required_action: Validate/symmetrize the tensor, include all entries and define a real dimensionless diagnostic.

findings.finding: Manual serialization can emit invalid JSON for control characters and NaN/Inf, and default precision is lossy.
findings.required_action: Use a JSON library, reject/encode non-finite values, set full precision and add schema/version/input hashes.

findings.finding: The field conditioning is an eigenvalue-magnitude ratio, not eigenproblem conditioning; a defective matrix returned conditioning=1.
findings.required_action: Rename the metric and add left/right eigenvector or resolvent-based conditioning with normalized residuals.

findings.finding: Source-checkout lookup resolves to src/resources rather than repository-root resources; six tests fail without SSTCORE_RESOURCES.
findings.required_action: Add a correct repository-root path and test clean editable/source checkouts.

findings.finding: Only x-axis boosts exist and invariant residual divides by abs(s2)+1.0, introducing an undeclared unit scale.
findings.required_action: Add arbitrary-direction boosts and dimensionally consistent normalization.

findings.finding: One epsilon mixes pressure and dimensionless ratio tolerances; negative pressures are accepted; rank-9 Pass lacks a conditioning ceiling.
findings.required_action: Separate tolerances, validate domains and gate on conditioning.

findings.finding: npm test runs only test_basic.js; new module tests are not part of the default command; index.d.ts largely hides gaps behind an index signature.
findings.required_action: Use a unified Node test runner and explicitly type the new APIs.

findings.finding: list_bindings reports 291 functions and 0 classes, misclassifying pybind classes.
findings.required_action: Use PyType_Check or equivalent and add expected-class tests.

findings.finding: The wheel audit did not finish; it exposed stale py_modules, ambiguous resource package discovery and deprecated license metadata.
findings.required_action: Clean package discovery/metadata and pre-generate or cache embedded resources.

findings.finding: Future mtimes triggered unnecessary CMake rebuild behavior.
findings.required_action: Normalize archive mtimes for reproducible builds.

findings.finding: package.json, setup.py, Python __version__ and sstcore_version.h agree on 0.8.28.
findings.required_action: Keep the version guard.

findings.finding: The static C++ library builds and test_frenet, test_sst_integrator and test_resolved_tube_geometry all pass.
findings.required_action: Preserve these as mandatory CI gates.

findings.finding: With an audit-only CMake link fix and correct resource path, 139 tests pass and 25 skip.
findings.required_action: Use this as the remediation baseline.

findings.finding: The planned C++/Python modules for 0.8.20 through 0.8.28 are substantially present.
findings.required_action: Focus next work on rigor, bindings and release completeness rather than rewriting.
